title: Termwise product functor on strict tower complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with countable products [def-weil-category-product]. A strict tower is a functor $\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal A$, with level $n\in\mathbf N$ denoting positive level $n+1$. For a cochain complex $X$ of strict towers, write $X_n$ for the evaluated complex and use the explicit product $\operatorname{roosP}(X)=\prod_n X_n$ and product maps $\operatorname{roosPmap}(f)=\prod_n f_n$ of [def-weil-strict-roos-model]. Define the termwise product functor $\Pi:C(\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal A)\to C(\mathcal A)$ by $\Pi(X)=\operatorname{roosP}(X)$ and $\Pi(f)=\operatorname{roosPmap}(f)$. Its identity and composition laws are the existing laws for these product maps. The complexes are unbounded and cohomologically indexed by $\mathbf Z$; no exactness of products and no hypothesis on tower transitions is imposed.
